body.body:
[Project notice](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/blob/1bac5ac9a5b51c4a0277e3f5bfd08c80cf6a6d3e/docs/DISCLAIMER_SNIPPET.md)

# Summary

Fix the two P2 findings from [review5610481904](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/pull/4851#pullrequestreview-5610481904) on #4851. A CRLF checkout could generate normalized hashes that disagree with raw source bytes; an apparently external evidence path could follow a symlink into the checkout.

- Pin the complete41-input byte-hashed closure and generated identities to LF while preserving the opaque manuscript rules.
- Resolve the real repository/output/nearest existing ancestor; preflight every finite report destination before any directory creation or write. Recheck canonical destinations on writes. Preserve the original16 campaign calls and immediate partial-failure evidence.
- Cover ordinary directory/file aliases, missing ancestors, dangling links, checkout aliases and internal two-dot-prefix names, plus valid external output. The new LF query uses an owned temporary Git fixture and works without source-checkout Git metadata.

Public head `1bac5ac9a5b51c4a0277e3f5bfd08c80cf6a6d3e`, tree `33c13a46596b56db79da7bd73b705da4afd7d36c`, sole parent actual main `87a003d23d3093edac3747ee1f9da292c6159515`. The four raw files and complete public tree delta have been read back; all other source bodies/modes remain exact. This unsigned public commit has the same complete tree as local `e7693280c650c2f73d48672a1e784de728eb9ec2`; their histories are distinct.

All52 paper files, all41 runtime inputs/sourceHash `644258ac21cc938aff861d02ad728e8f3c9716f6ea78700acc35e4d7400eebf2`, canonical/mirrored pages and catalogs, three workers,32 workflows/action pins,80% coverage and functional deadlines remain unchanged. The generator algorithm is unchanged.

# Checks

- [ ] Local full/changed pre-commit hook campaign
- [ ] Full project environment preflight
- [ ] Full pytest coverage campaign
- [ ] Current public-head `Lint (ruff)` and `Smoke tests`
- [ ] Complete configured review on this actual public head

# Testing

- Author:25 path cases PASS on Node22.17.1 and24.21.0;3 selected Python LF/actual-autocrlf/portable-generation tests PASS with pytest8.4.1/PyYAML6.0.2; Black/Ruff/syntax/diff checks PASS. The final test-only child reran the3 Python tests; unchanged JavaScript retains the two25-case runs.
- Independent:25 Node cases, final3 Python cases and the first LF test from an owned source copy without `.git` PASS. A real Git checkout makes the unpinned control physically CRLF while preserving every catalogued raw byte and generated identity. All16 deterministic campaign records remain equal, apart from actual wall-clock receipts and the changed reproducer's expected self-hash.
- Independent complete source identity:3,771 files/192,993,007 bytes,633 reconstructed trees; exact four-file delta and protected papers/generated/workflow bytes verified. Scoped review SHA256 `a8ac200b0544814863597b2e13b1978a53b057f6d2394ffc3d60bff17e8dbda9`. Author final portable report SHA256 `84a5ba799958428b8de1a4a7dde99773dc3063a2fa5accfd95c9fdec0307c392`.
- The minimal local interpreter lacks the full project's pip/NumPy/pandas environment; its preflight limitation and initial unavailable-pytest attempts remain recorded. No runtime packages were installed. Native Windows generation, full hosted hooks/browser/native/coverage and actual-main release qualification remain pending.

Addresses [4345508847](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/pull/4851#discussion_r4345508847) and [4345508855](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/pull/4851#discussion_r4345508855) in this proposed source. Original main87 attempt1 producers remain running and retain their own source scope. Existing different-SHA concurrency and exact-current-main publication guards are unchanged. Final companion/browser pins remain unset until repaired actual-main acceptance. Continuation coordination: #4850.

[Project notice](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/blob/bc281cc35faf6aeb9d53910031663e15d1b6f390/docs/DISCLAIMER_SNIPPET.md)

# Summary

Address three actual P2 findings from #4851 and this PR. Raw CRLF checkout bytes could disagree with the capability catalogue; lexical output paths could follow aliases into the checkout; adding LF attributes alone did not refresh unchanged files in an existing checkout.

- Pin the complete byte-hashed closure and generated identities to LF, preserving the opaque manuscript rules.
- Resolve the real output path and nearest existing ancestor, preflight every finite destination before writes, and preserve the original sixteen campaign calls and immediate partial-failure evidence.
- Provide an explicit, version-bound, stdlib-only checkout upgrade. Default dry-run writes nothing. Apply authenticates all 49 fixed bodies, refuses private edits or mixed endings before writes, retains all originals in an external private backup, and replaces only stale CRLF files with their pinned LF bytes. It never changes the Git index/configuration or runs a generator automatically.
- Cover actual parent-to-target Git upgrades, refusal and retained-backup behavior, alongside the earlier path and fresh-checkout regressions.

Public head `bc281cc35faf6aeb9d53910031663e15d1b6f390`, tree `d36301c17c4c53297aaa4d4c5cbf2c7b7387a775`, sole parent `1bac5ac9a5b51c4a0277e3f5bfd08c80cf6a6d3e`. All four new delta bodies were read back exactly; the complete public tree has 4,405 entries / 3,773 files / 193,022,773 raw bytes. The unsigned public commit has the same complete tree as local `be7485eb233aed8dd5d161627af0a4c3b9e5ddbb`; their histories are distinct. The combined PR changes seven paths from main87.

All 52 paper files, all 41 runtime inputs/sourceHash `644258ac21cc938aff861d02ad728e8f3c9716f6ea78700acc35e4d7400eebf2`, generated pages/catalogues/workers, 32 workflows/action pins, 80% coverage and functional deadlines remain exact. The upgrade helper and regression fixture are outside the runtime closure. The generator algorithm is unchanged.

# Validation

- Author: ten selected Python tests PASS, Black/Ruff/Flake8 PASS. The actual upgrade reproduced 47 stale files and 40 catalogue mismatches, then repaired all 49 bodies with original backups, modes, staged content, index, configuration and paper bytes preserved.
- Independent: the ordinary upgrade and private-edit refusal passed; seven new regressions PASS. All 633 trees were reconstructed from every raw/index/HEAD file; the exact four-path child delta and all protected identities match. Final scoped review SHA256 `8f5e5f783bc242c80f7412a6fbca17feb54ab678eb2d18c01e191b8a0c4b1092`; full independent manifest `3e5e13ecdf3f522b5c46a95bf5803df668b74b6eba2d8fd15f346c08102c00fe`. Author report `5f81471710b5c8f8021386f67ef6fdebdff1f5feb8406b0918b65c604f069995`.
- Earlier unchanged JavaScript retains its 25-case Node22.17.1 and Node24.21.0 runs; earlier portable LF/generation tests and independent sixteen-record campaign comparison remain source-scoped evidence.
- The initial upgrade test's clean-Git-status expectation failed after the byte repair; that log remains. The final contract checks raw bytes and unchanged index, with an empty ordinary diff. No clean-status/index-refresh, concurrent-writer, rollback or durability guarantee is claimed.
- Native Windows, full environment/pre-commit/coverage/browser/native campaigns and actual-main release qualification remain separate. Local strict mypy and full pip/NumPy/pandas environment preflight were unavailable/refused; no packages were installed.

# Current gates

- [ ] Required current-public-head `Lint (ruff)` and `Smoke tests`
- [ ] Completed configured review on this exact public head
- [ ] All repository-enforced merge requirements

The configured review automatically started on this new head at 08:23:49Z; no duplicate manual request was sent. The prior `1bac` finding [4345797435](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/pull/4859#discussion_r4345797435) remains a historical observation on that head; current-head review must evaluate this explicit upgrade. Earlier #4851 findings [4345508847](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/pull/4851#discussion_r4345508847) and [4345508855](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGI-Alpha-Agent-v0/pull/4851#discussion_r4345508855) and the late-review merge chronology remain preserved in #4850.

Main `87a003d23d3093edac3747ee1f9da292c6159515` is still intermediate and unaccepted. Its original attempt1 producers and the six original `1bac` PR runs continue unchanged. Fresh branch-wide preflight found no active downstream CI Health run; its unchanged completion-trigger pending-slot behavior remains monitored. Different-SHA direct concurrency and exact-current-main publication guards are unchanged. Final companion/browser pins remain unset until repaired actual-main acceptance.
